name: Textarea
description: A multi-line text field for longer text like comments and descriptions. It can grow as you type.

classes.ayy-textarea--sm: Small: 4rem tall to start, tighter padding, sm text. Pairs with a small Input.
classes.ayy-textarea--lg: Large: 6.5rem tall to start, more padding, lg text.
classes.ayy-textarea--autosize: Grows with content (CSS field-sizing). Falls back to fixed height.

default.looks: Like Input: wash fill, line-strong border; at least 5rem tall, resizable vertically.

focus.looks: 2px ring just inside the edge; the border goes transparent.

error.looks: Border 60% destructive, destructive focus ring. Forced colours: dashed border.

loading.none: No loading look; disable it and show a Spinner in the submit Button while the text is sent.

scale.sm: Control sm text, 8px side padding, at least 4rem tall.
scale.md: Control field text, 12px side padding, at least 5rem tall.
scale.lg: Control lg text, 16px side padding, at least 6.5rem tall.

sizes.density: Text follows the control scale and data-density; the minimum heights and padding don't change. A data-size scope doesn't resize it (it is multi-line): set size on it.
sizes.width: Fills its container. autosize grows with its content (Chromium; elsewhere it keeps 5rem and scrolls).

js: textareaClass({ size?, autosize?, mono?, className? }) → string
a11y: Label it (Field + Label), same as Input.
do: Use a textarea for descriptions, notes, prompts and config snippets (mono).
Set rows for a sensible starting height.
dont: Don't use it for rich text editing — use a dedicated editor and theme it with ayywi tokens.
Don't disable resize on non-autosize textareas; users need it.
